author: lockRuby
body:
A DTM map specifically designed for the tournament by FluenZa_, ParaSpider, and I. This features a jungle layout with lots of different points to use against the enemy, TNT, redstone, diamonds, many different levels of gameplay, an underground, supply chests, and a spawn tunnel as well as portals. Though it may seem complicated, I imagine it will play well. If some teams want to scrimmage on it, I've decided unlike the other maps to put up a public download. This was posted for Para, and I contributed to the map a littleeee bit.
